messages:
Maya (PM): quick check 1 post-launch for Search Relevance. support has 18 tickets in 48h; 3 P1 (empty for long queries), ~12 medium (ranking odd), 3 low UI. Acme flagged workflow regression. do we go bug-first or mix enhancements?
Ajay (ENG): need counts + repro. severity + repro rate drives action.
Maya (PM): sent summary above.
Liam (SRE): if P1s in prod, consider rollback or hotfix. what's p99 impact?
deploy-bot: :information_source: deployment 2026-03-22T14:12Z succeeded search-service-v2
Sophie (PD): some ranking issues look prompt-template related 1 might be prompt mismatch or model slice.
Ajay (ENG): propose buckets: hotfix (P1/P2 perf/regressions), rollback candidate (model variant), enhancements (UX/ranking). owners: hotfix->Ajay, rollback eval->Liam+infra, enhancements->Sophie+Maya.
Maya (PM): can we codify decision rubric?
Ajay (ENG): draft rubric: Severity | ActiveUsers | ReproRate | SLAExposure | Action. P1/P2 | >50 | >10% | High -> Immediate fix or rollback. P3 | <=50 | <10% | Medium -> Sprint schedule. P4 | cosmetic | <1% | Low -> Backlog.
Maya (PM): add owner + ETA column?
Ajay (ENG): owner + 48h assessment for P1/P2, 5bd for P3, next groom for P4.
Liam (SRE): rollback impacts canary metrics; prepare smoke/canary checklist.
Sophie (PD): pair each customer-facing fix with prompt regression tests runnable in Redwood Console.
Maya (PM): action items: 1) Ajay triage 3 P1s and estimate fix vs rollback by EOD. 2) Liam prepare rollback playbook + smoke checklist. 3) Sophie assemble prompt regression set for Acme + top queries. 4) Groom Friday 10:30 PT to slot medium items.
Ajay (ENG): ack, triage now. if fix >2d we'll flag rollback.
Liam (SRE): ack, prepping runbook. include TTL, KV cache, prefix invalidation, p95/p99 baseline.
Sophie (PD): exporting top queries and evaluation script. can someone add a small Redwood Optimize job to compare v1 vs v2?
Maya (PM): Ajay create PRD-lite per hotfix (cause, owner, ETA, rollback) and ping thread.
Ajay (ENG): will do and link PRD-lite here.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary pause if error rate >2% for 5m.
Maya (PM): if new P1s tag #postlaunch-hot and @Maya. reconvene after triage. :thumbsup:
